item.description:

con 0.1.0-beta.190 · 2026-11-26

Terminal

item.title: Version 0.1.0-beta.189
item.description:
What’s new

con 0.1.0-beta.189 · 2026-11-26

Fixed

Terminal

  • Upgrade to libghostty-vt 1.0.2. Mouse-tracking TUIs on Windows and Linux receive fewer redundant motion events during redraws. The shared terminal engine also preserves soft wraps and prompt markers when rows move, and keeps Kitty images visible while their replacements arrive.PR #571 by @wey-gu

macOS

  • Restore Codex conversations by their saved session ID when Codex omits the transcript path. Claude Code recovery now preserves the original configuration selection, including the API-key approval associated with it.PR #570 by @adaiguoguo
  • Fix upload of signed macOS release packages when bundled themes contain characters unsupported by GitHub Actions artifact storage.PR #572 by @wey-gu
Read the full changelog

item.title: Version 0.1.0-beta.183
item.description:
What’s new

con 0.1.0-beta.183 · 2026-11-17

Fixed

Updates

  • Add a persistent Automatically Check for Updates switch in Settings → General → Updates. Turning it off stops background checks while keeping manual checks available. Show the actual checking preference instead of the ambiguous “Auto-update enabled” status.PR #565 by @wey-gu

Changed

Updates

  • Require an explicit installation decision for each con-managed release. macOS no longer offers silent automatic downloading or installation; portable updates retain separate download and restart actions. Package-managed installations continue using their original update mechanism.PR #565 by @wey-gu
Read the full changelog

item.title: Version 0.1.0-beta.174
item.description:
What’s new

con 0.1.0-beta.174 · 2026-11-08

Added

Updates

  • Read the offered version’s changes before deciding to upgrade. macOS shows release notes in its native update prompt; Windows and Linux show a compact changelog alongside download, cancel and skip controls.PR #554 by @wey-gu

Changed

Windows, Linux

  • Download and verify updates while continuing to work, then restart when ready. Recognized per-user installations update the app and companion CLI together with signature verification, backups and rollback, without launching an installer console. Package-managed and custom installations retain their original update method. Restart closes running terminals and agents; existing session recovery settings apply.PR #554 by @wey-gu
Read the full changelog
